note: Private Switch 2 (S2Arm) test IPA 802 = the common IPA 725 rebuilt with the S2Arm device probe only (second probe build: 801 hung on device at the fixed placement, fixed in 7195731): package packages/s2arm_probe (static pod linked into Runner), its workspace and dependency lines in pubspec.yaml, the host Info.plist boolean RewindBoxS2ArmProbe = true and the source declaration review of that change. The base is the delivered 724, the base of 725 itself, with the classification of the frozen 725 manifest: taking 725 as the base would declare App.framework as an image that must change (the recipe derives it from pubspec.yaml), while the probe adds no Dart the application reaches, so App would keep the payload of 725 and the image check would refuse the build. The two common-line message fixes made after 725 (68846c65, f3a4180f) are source only, so the effective tree is the one of 725 plus the probe. Same application identifier as the common IPA. Not a common-line build.
